title: Skyfire Artists
deck: A lightning bolt in a square, from sign to cap.
lede: For Skyfire Artists, a single mark, a lightning bolt breaking out of a square, carries everything from the wall sign and business card to the merch. In motion, it splits into color.
challenge: Skyfire Artists, in Los Angeles, needed its whole brand at once: logos, merchandise and graphics for its website and social channels, all from one idea.
work: The idea is a bolt that won't stay inside its box. The logo sets a lightning bolt in a square above the name, in white on black and black on white, and an animated version splits the bolt into color.
Every asset came from that mark. It was set out on a projecting sign, a window, a business card, a tote, three caps and a tee, and across the website and social graphics.
system: A lightning bolt breaking out of a square.
credits: Dalton Corr: brand design, logos, merchandise, web and social graphics
